notebooks.title: 相关函数与白噪声边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
from itertools import product

cells.code:
biased=[(2+z0,2+z1) for z0,z1 in product([-1,1],repeat=2)]
mx=sp.Rational(sum(x for x,y in biased),4)
r0=sp.Rational(sum(x*x for x,y in biased),4)
r1=sp.Rational(sum(x*y for x,y in biased),4)
print('带偏置均值/同刻R/C/异刻R/C:',mx,r0,r0-mx**2,r1,r1-mx**2)
rows=[(L*e0,L*e1) for L,e0,e1 in product([1,2],[-1,1],[-1,1])]
print('白噪声反例配置数:',len(rows))
print('均值/方差/跨时协方差:',sp.Rational(sum(x for x,y in rows),8),sp.Rational(sum(x*x for x,y in rows),8),sp.Rational(sum(x*y for x,y in rows),8))
joint=sp.Rational(sum(abs(x)==1 and abs(y)==1 for x,y in rows),8)
margin=sp.Rational(sum(abs(x)==1 for x,y in rows),8)
print('绝对值同时1/边缘乘积:',joint,margin**2)
constants=[-1,1]
print('随机常量的时间均值可能值/总体均值/均方误差:',constants,sp.Rational(sum(constants),2),sp.Rational(sum(v*v for v in constants),2))

a,q=sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(3,4)
P=[sp.Integer(0)]
for k in range(12):
    P.append(a*a*P[-1]+q)
steady=q/(1-a*a)
print('P0到P3/平稳方差:',P[:4],steady)
print('P12/距离极限:',P[12],steady-P[12])
print('从零开始C(3,1)/C(2,0):',a**2*P[1],a**2*P[0])
print('宽平稳gamma0到3:',[steady*a**l for l in range(4)])
print('二阶矩初始化下X0取值:',[-1,1])
print('X1取值:',sorted({s0*a+s1*sp.sqrt(q) for s0 in [-1,1] for s1 in [-1,1]},key=float))

notebooks.title: 相关平均与谱归一化
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import quad
import math

cells.code:
n=4
for a in [sp.Rational(-1,2),sp.Integer(0),sp.Rational(1,2)]:
    gamma=[a**l for l in range(4)]
    v=(n*gamma[0]+2*sum((n-l)*gamma[l] for l in range(1,n)))/n**2
    print('a/q/四点平均方差:',a,1-a*a,v)
spectrum=lambda t:.75/(1+.5**2-2*.5*math.cos(t))
print('谱0/pi2/pi:',[spectrum(t) for t in [0,math.pi/2,math.pi]])
print('谱积分归一方差:',quad(spectrum,-math.pi,math.pi,epsabs=1e-12,epsrel=1e-12)[0]/(2*math.pi))
print('平稳AR四点平均方差:',sp.Rational(33,64),'随机常量过程4点方差:',1)

T=sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(4,5),sp.Rational(1,5)],[sp.Rational(3,10),sp.Rational(7,10)]])
p=sp.Matrix([[1,0]])
pi=sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(3,5),sp.Rational(2,5)]])
print('转移行和:',[sum(T.row(i)) for i in range(2)])
print('p1/p2:',p*T,p*T*T)
print('平稳分布/残差:',pi,pi*T-pi)
print('k4开门概率/闭式:',(p*T**4)[1],sp.Rational(2,5)*(1-sp.Rational(1,2)**4))
flip=sp.Matrix([[0,1],[1,0]])
print('交替链k0到3:',[p*flip**k for k in range(4)])
print('交替链平稳分布残差:',sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,2)]])*flip-sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,2)]]))

A=sp.diag(sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,4))
Q=sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(3,4),sp.Rational(1,4)],[sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(15,16)]])
P0=sp.zeros(2)
P1=A*P0*A.T+Q
P2=A*P1*A.T+Q
Ps=sp.Matrix([[1,sp.Rational(2,7)],[sp.Rational(2,7),1]])
print('P1/P2:',P1,P2)
print('Q与Ps行列式:',Q.det(),Ps.det())
print('Lyapunov残差:',Ps-A*Ps*A.T-Q)
print('A特征值:',A.eigenvals())

notebooks.title: 游走与布朗增量协方差
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
from itertools import product

cells.code:
paths=list(product([-1,1],repeat=4))
for k in range(5):
    values=[sum(path[:k]) for path in paths]
    print('游走k/均值/方差:',k,sp.Rational(sum(values),16),sp.Rational(sum(v*v for v in values),16))
print('游走C(4,2):',sp.Rational(sum(sum(p[:4])*sum(p[:2]) for p in paths),16))
times=[1,2,4]
C=sp.Matrix([[min(t,s) for s in times] for t in times])
D=sp.Matrix([[1,0,0],[-1,1,0],[0,-1,1]])
print('Brownian取样协方差:',C)
print('不重叠增量协方差:',D*C*D.T)

print('题1均值/同刻R,C/异刻R,C:',2,5,1,4,0,'常量过程平均均方误差1')
print('题2 P1,P2,P3,Ps:',sp.Rational(3,4),sp.Rational(15,16),sp.Rational(63,64),1)
print('题2平稳gamma0,1,2:',1,sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,4))
print('题3平均方差/谱0,pi2,pi/归一:',sp.Rational(33,64),[3,sp.Rational(3,5),sp.Rational(1,3)],1)
T=sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(4,5),sp.Rational(1,5)],[sp.Rational(3,10),sp.Rational(7,10)]])
p=sp.Matrix([[1,0]])
print('题4:',p*T,p*T*T,sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(3,5),sp.Rational(2,5)]]))
A=sp.diag(sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,4))
Q=sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(3,4),sp.Rational(1,4)],[sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(15,16)]])
Ps=sp.Matrix([[1,sp.Rational(2,7)],[sp.Rational(2,7),1]])
print('题5 P1/P2/Ps/残差:',Q,A*Q*A.T+Q,Ps,Ps-A*Ps*A.T-Q)
print('题6:',4,2,[1,1,2])
